messages:
Lina M: heads-up, SCIM provisioning to a few customers started failing after yesterday's IdP cert rotation. getting TLS / cert chain errors from our SCIM client when POSTing to IdP metadata endpoint
Lina M: error snippet from logs: ```x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
POST https://idp.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration -> tls: failed to verify certificate chain```
Matt H: is this the external IdP or our internal proxy?
Lina M: external customer IdP, same cert bundle they rotated. Affected 3 orgs so far.
Sam R: can you paste the full curl output with -v? often shows which cert in chain is missing
Lina M: ```* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Client hello (1): * TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Server hello (2): * TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Certificate (11): * error:14094412:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert handshake failure
* Closing connection 0
curl: (60) SSL certificate problem: unable to get local issuer certificate```
Kevin P: sounds like the intermediate CA isn't present in the IdP's chain. We can workaround by pulling their full chain and adding verification exceptions but shouldn't do that long-term.
Lina M: Also seeing SCIM response code 401 for a customer where cert looked fine. audit-bot shows a partial RBAC change for SCIM role mapping around the same time. possible two separate issues?
Matt H: @audit-bot can you dump the RBAC change events for those orgs between 2026-03-18T20:00Z and 2026-03-19T02:00Z?
audit-bot: event dump for orgs a123, b456, c789: [2026-03-18T21:12Z] role_mapping:update user.scim_write false -> true by Kevin P; [2026-03-18T23:45Z] role_mapping:update user.scim_write true -> false by onboarding-bot
Sam R: interesting — one org had scim_write revoked which would explain 401s. That is separate from cert errors. Lina, can you correlate which orgs had TLS errors vs 401s?
Lina M: a123 and b456 TLS cert errors; c789 401 and RBAC change.
Kevin P: c789's RBAC revoke was from an automated onboarding script we pushed yesterday — looks like a bug in the script. I'll patch it to not flip scim_write off.
Lina M: for TLS ones, I reached out to the customer's IdP admin. they sent back the server cert only, not chain. I requested full chain and said to include intermediate and root as served by their endpoint.
Matt H: temporary mitigation: our SCIM client can accept a custom CA bundle per org (we added for legacy SAML). we could upload the intermediate to our trust store for those two orgs while they fix their IdP. need approval from security ops since it's per-org exception to default PKI handling.
Sam R: approve if limited duration (7 days) and tracked ticket for each org. also audit log entry and admin notification.
Kevin P: I'll create the PR to support per-org CA bundles and a feature flag to opt-in only for affected orgs. patch will include automatic expiry and audit entries.
Lina M: good. also noticed KMS errors in the same timeframe for one customer: when we tried to decrypt a SCIM webhook secret we saw `kms:Decrypt failed: key not found`. could be unrelated but want to triage.
Matt H: key not found usually means key alias mismatch after key rotation or keys in a different region/account. did we rotate keys for that org?
Lina M: they did a key rotation yesterday per support ticket, but we didn't receive notification. contacting them for key ARNs.
Sam R: checklist for this thread: 1) Request full cert chain from affected IdPs (Lina) 2) Short-term per-org CA bundle enable with 7-day expiry + audit (Kevin) 3) Revert onboarding script that revoked scim_write and patch (Kevin) 4) Correlate KMS key ARNs and fix decrypt mismatch (Matt) 5) Postmortem with timeline and customer communication (Lina/Matt)
Lina M: I'll open the incident ticket and add timeline + affected orgs, and draft customer-facing note once we have mitigations.
Matt H: if any org can't provide chain quickly, push per-org CA bundle and set monitoring for SCIM failures to auto-alert.
Kevin P: PR #789 will include: feature flag, admin approval gating, audit entries, and auto-expiry tag. aiming for hotfix deploy in next 6 hours.
Sam R: after hotfix, run smoke tests: SCIM provisioning, webhook decryption, and role mapping checks against test orgs.
Lina M: thx all — I'll update thread when I have cert chains and KMS ARNs. :thumbsup:
